sim.console_subtitle: Inspect real connections, current positions, and messages before testing.
sim.terminals_subtitle: Manage each terminal’s identity and server connection.
sim.routes_tasks_subtitle: Import WGS84 polylines and assign trajectory playback to terminals.
sim.logs_subtitle: Keeps the latest {limit} records in memory, newest first.

dialog.terminal_description: Configure the terminal identity and server connection.
dialog.route_description: Import WGS84 coordinates, validate the trajectory, then save.
dialog.task_description: Choose a terminal and route for coordinate playback.
dialog.import_description: Review a JSON backup before replacing local configuration.
dialog.export_description: Copy a JSON backup of the current terminals, routes, and tasks.
dialog.log_description: Inspect the recorded message, decoded fields, and original HEX.

sim.discard_changes_body: Your changes have not been saved. Discarding them cannot be undone.
sim.no_terminals_console: Add a terminal and configure its server. Connections, tasks, and message counts come from real activity; no online devices are preloaded.
sim.no_terminals_management: Give each terminal a unique 12-digit phone number and device identity. Your workspace starts empty.
sim.no_routes_hint: Paste or import CSV with an explicit # WGS84 header and at least two coordinate points.
sim.no_tasks_hint: Choose a terminal and route to create a speed-based playback task.
sim.no_tasks_dependencies: Add a terminal and a route before creating a playback task.
sim.no_assigned_task: No task assigned to this terminal
sim.manual_mode_hint: Edit and report a position manually, or assign playback in Routes & tasks.
sim.connection_details: Connection diagnostics. Check the address, port, and platform authentication before reconnecting.
sim.auth_hint: Leave empty to register first. Codes returned by the platform are stored in the local workspace.
sim.auto_reconnect_hint: Off by default. When enabled, unexpected disconnects trigger retries; a manual disconnect stays disconnected.
sim.terminals_help: Uses 2013 registration fields: manufacturer up to 5 bytes, model up to 20 bytes, and terminal ID up to 7 bytes. Disconnect before changing configuration.
sim.position_local: Local position draft; no confirmed position report yet.
sim.position_reporting: Current local position. A sent record does not mean the platform acknowledged the position.
sim.manual_location_hint: Apply locally first, then report immediately when online.
sim.manual_during_task: Playback controls the coordinates. You can still apply ACC, position-fixed, and alarm flags; pause or stop before editing coordinates manually.
sim.hex32_hint: Use 1–8 hexadecimal digits, optionally prefixed by 0x; range 0x00000000–0xFFFFFFFF.
sim.location_applied: Local position applied. No message was sent by this action.
sim.location_sent: Position message sent. Check the protocol log for the platform response.
sim.task_waiting: Waiting for terminal to be online
sim.route_format_help: Start with # WGS84, followed by latitude,longitude,speed rows. Use 2–10000 points and speeds of 1–200 km/h. BD-09 and GCJ-02 coordinates are not converted automatically.
sim.preview_stale: Content changed; preview has not been refreshed.
sim.routes_help: Distances are calculated from coordinates. Lines do not imply drivable roads.
sim.loop_hint: Restart from the first point after the last. Connecting roads are not planned automatically.
sim.task_start_hint: Starting attempts to connect the terminal. Playback advances only while authenticated and online. Each terminal allows one running or paused task at a time.
sim.playback_help: Progress and mileage reflect actual playback. Disconnecting pauses the task; resume manually after reconnecting. Movement advances at the terminal’s reporting interval, not as road navigation.
sim.map_online_hint: Load OpenStreetMap tiles on demand. Requires network access and sends tile requests to the provider.
sim.no_coordinates: Add coordinates to preview a trajectory.
sim.coordinate_plot: Actual WGS84 coordinate polyline without road data
sim.map_disclaimer: Blue lines show the input trajectory, not road navigation. Coordinates are never converted silently.
sim.map_failed: Online tiles failed to load. The offline coordinate plot is shown instead. Check the network before enabling online tiles again.
sim.no_logs_hint: Real send, receive, and event records appear after connecting a terminal or sending a message.
sim.no_matching_logs: No records match these filters. Clear the search or broaden the filters.
sim.clear_logs_confirm: Clear in-memory logs only? Terminal connections and receiving will continue.
sim.export_logs_hint: Copies live logs for the selected terminal. Text and direction filters, and display pause, do not affect exported records.
sim.display_paused_hint: Only this list is frozen; terminals are still receiving. There are {count} live records in memory.
sim.header_valid: 2013 header, length, and XOR checksum passed
sim.header_invalid: This record is not a supported complete 2013 frame. Original diagnostics and HEX are preserved below; check delimiters, escaping, length, and checksum.
sim.no_packet: This event has no raw packet.
sim.raw_send_hint: Authenticated online terminals only. Supply a complete 2013 frame; checksums are not generated for you.
sim.raw_hex_hint: Complete hexadecimal frame with both 7E delimiters
sim.raw_send_failed: Frame was not sent. Check 7E delimiters, byte pairs, escaping, length, XOR checksum, and terminal phone, then retry.
sim.raw_sent: Raw frame sent. Check the platform response.
sim.workspace_help: Terminals, routes, tasks, and theme are stored locally. Connections, playback progress, and logs are not restored as online state.
sim.workspace_secret_warning: Workspace JSON includes plaintext authentication codes and server details. Store and transfer it only on trusted devices; remove sensitive fields before sharing.
sim.replace_workspace_confirm: Import {terminals} terminals, {routes} routes, and {tasks} tasks. Continuing disconnects all terminals and clears task runtime before replacing current configuration. Back up first; this cannot be undone.
sim.save_failure: Local save failed. Changes are still in memory and may be lost when you quit. Retry saving, or export a workspace backup from Settings.
sim.load_failure_recovery: Existing data is protected: creating and replacing the workspace is blocked. Check local storage permissions and retry. Existing files are unchanged.
sim.support_scope_body: JT/T 808-2013 over native TCP. Supports registration, authentication, heartbeat, position reporting, platform general responses, position queries, parameter setting and queries, text delivery, and temporary position tracking. Logs show actual transmitted frames.
sim.unsupported_scope: JT/T 808-2019, JT/T 1078 audio/video, encrypted messages, and segmentation are not supported. Unknown messages are not presented as supported behavior.
sim.coordinate_policy_body: Routes require explicit WGS84 coordinates. Actual polylines are plotted offline by default. OpenStreetMap tiles are optional and fall back on failure. No Baidu key or invented city roads are used.
sim.reference_disclaimer: Reference projects inform protocol and interaction design; their full feature sets are not claimed by this tool.

errors.invalid_phone: Terminal phone must contain exactly 12 digits.
errors.invalid_region: Province and city IDs must be between 0 and 65535.
errors.invalid_identity: Check the characters and lengths of manufacturer, model, and terminal ID.
errors.invalid_plate: Enter a vehicle identifier and select a valid plate color.
errors.invalid_interval: Heartbeat and position intervals must be between 1 and 3600 seconds.
errors.invalid_coordinates: Use finite coordinates: latitude -90–90 and longitude -180–180.
errors.invalid_motion: Check the allowed speed, altitude, and heading ranges.
errors.invalid_flags: Use valid unsigned 32-bit HEX flags and check the mileage range.
errors.disconnect_before_edit: This terminal is connecting or online. Disconnect before editing or deleting it.
errors.duplicate_phone: Another terminal uses this phone number. Enter a unique number.
errors.terminal_in_use: This terminal is referenced by a task. Delete the related task first.
errors.stop_before_edit: Stop the related task before editing configuration.
errors.route_in_use: This route is referenced by a task. Delete the related task first.
errors.task_dependencies: Create and select a valid terminal and route first.
errors.connect_first: Connect the terminal and wait for authenticated online status before sending.
errors.terminal_task_busy: This terminal already has a running or paused task. Stop that task first.
errors.disconnect_before_import: Disconnect all terminals before replacing the workspace.
errors.route_coordinate_header: The first CSV line must be # WGS84. Confirm and convert source coordinates yourself; automatic conversion is not performed.
errors.route_csv_invalid: Each row must be latitude,longitude,speed with valid coordinates and speed of 1–200 km/h.
errors.route_zero_length: Total route length must be greater than zero. Check for coincident points.
errors.invalid_hex: Enter complete hexadecimal byte pairs, optionally separated by whitespace, up to 2074 bytes.
errors.invalid_workspace: Workspace JSON is invalid or its version is unsupported. Check terminal fields, unique IDs, WGS84 routes, and task references before retrying. Current data was not replaced.
errors.file_unreadable: Cannot read the file, or it exceeds 20 MB. Select a valid text file or paste from the clipboard.
errors.invalid_theme: Invalid theme option. Select a theme again.
errors.operation_failed: The action could not finish. Check input, connection, and system permissions, then retry. Protocol diagnostics are available in the log.
